final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS average_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(r.film_count) AS total_count, AVG(r.film_count - a.average_count) AS average_difference FROM rating_counts AS r CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE r.film_count > a.average_count
